QuestInfo.name: Planting Trees
QuestInfo.0: I heard #p512# is looking for ways to liven up the barren grounds of Perion.
QuestInfo.1: Thanks to the excavation project, #m10004000# and its surrounding areas have been rapidly deteriorating. To liven up the area, #p512# wanted me to get him Seedlings to plant around the area. Get #p512# #b50 #t4000151#s#k from #r#o39#s#k at #rExcavation Sites#k.
QuestInfo.2: I defeated #o39# and collected #t4000151#. #p512# promised to liven up the currently-barren #m10004000# by planting lots of trees around the area, and he'll be the first to start it.

0.0: #m10004000# has been steadily deteriorating these days. It seems barren to begin with because of the rocky landscape, but it's also because of the recent excavation project that has been affecting areas around #m10004000#. The sheer digging only speeds up the deterioration. I, for one, would like to restore Perion to its previous, glorious days. Would you like to help me out?

yes.0: I can't thank you enough for stepping up for #m10004000#. New monsters have been popping up lately, with the land around Perion rapidly deteriorating. Recent reports suggest that a mutant version of the #o6#s, #r#o39#s#k, have been roaming around the area.
yes.1: After studying the #o39#, I learned that if the tree branches on the top of #o39#s' heads are planted on the ground, they will grow into huge trees. It's kind of like #t4000151#. Please head to the excavation site and eliminate #o39#s, while gathering up #b50 #t4000151#s#k for me. I'll surely appreciate it.
yes.2: #o39# appears quite often around the excavation site. The way to get there is quite simple. Head all the way East until you reach #r#m10004080##k. There, you'll see a portal at the very top. Enter the portal to head to the excavation site.

no.0: Did I ask for something too difficult...? I sincerely hope the #m10004000# area transforms into a green forest with trees to spare...

yes.0: Great job. The #t4000151# will be planted all around Perion, and hopefully that'll turn into a huge, green forest. I may be in it by myself for now, but once people start helping out, it'll speed up the process. You should plant one around your house yourself.
yes.1: Anyway, I feel this weird vibe going around the excavation site... wonder what that is.
